messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to push onprem-installer v1.9.0-private-2026-03 into the private delivery pipeline this Friday during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Need final pin, cosign, and transport checks.
kevin: Ack. I can do the cosign step and upload signatures once artifacts are staged in the offsite bucket.
olivia: Can we do a small canary first (3 hosts) + 15m observation before full cutover?
maria: Yes canary=3, 15m observation. Also we need the manifest epoch to be pinned to avoid staggered tag resolution.
ryan: Re KMS: key rotation completed earlier today. devsecops confirmed signer key id: projects/redwood-kms/keys/onprem-signer/versions/7. Use that for cosign.
devsecops: Confirmed. Cosign key published to internal KMS. Don't use local private key blobs.
kevin: Uploading sha256 + cosign now to /offsite/releases/2026/03/installer-v1.9.0/
kevin: SHA256: 9f3b2a6c5a8d4e9f1a2b3c4d5e6f70819a2b3c4d5e6f70819a2b3c4d5e6f708
kevin: cosign signature: cosign.sig (stored alongside artifact)
maria: Good. I'll update the release manifest with epoch_pin: 20260311-epoch7 and annotate rollback_fallback: installer@sha256:oldfallbacksha
olivia: Deploy bot — please schedule canary at 02:15 UTC and allocate three canary nodes in az-private-1.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: onprem-installer:v1.9.0-private-2026-03 · mode=canary · targets=3 · start=3885075300 (2026-03-11T02:15Z) · step=immediate
maria: Also adding acceptance checks: postinstall healthy < 2% error rate, kube pods ready within 5m, preflight checksum verification on each host.
ryan: Adding transport validations: verify cosign and sha256 on receiving host:
```
cosign verify --key projects/redwood-kms/keys/onprem-signer/versions/7 cosign.sig onprem-installer.tar.gz
sha256sum -c installer.tar.gz.sha256
```
kevin: If any verification fails, the deploy-bot should auto-abort and mark rollback_reason=checksum_mismatch_or_bad_sig.
deploy-bot: noted. abort policy configured: on verify_fail -> abort & notify #eng-releases; on postinstall_fail -> auto-fallback to pinned manifest if < 10% hosts failing; if >=10% then abort and escalate to oncall.
sre-bot: Oncall rotation for the window: primary=samuel, secondary=hana. Pager escalation set to 5m.
olivia: For rollback plan: we will keep previous sealed bundle (installer@sha256:oldfallbacksha) available in /offsite/releases/2026/02/ for immediate republishing. Rollback steps: 1) pin manifest to oldfallbacksha 2) trigger deploy-bot rollback 3) run post-rollback sanity checks.
maria: One more: network transit courier (airgap transport) will start checksum handshake at 01:45 UTC. Ops to confirm courier manifest signed-off by 01:30.
kevin: Courier handshake acked. Cosign timestamped 2026-03-11T01:10Z.
ryan: Quick note: installer upgrade includes kernel module loader change. We'll include a short downtime note in release notes: "may require node reboot" — operations informed.
olivia: Add customers on private contracts: list sent to legal and sales. We only do private deliveries within SLA windows.
maria: Final checklist before start (02:00 UTC):
- artifacts present in offsite bucket (kevin)
- cosign + KMS verify (kevin/devsecops)
- courier signed manifest (ops)
- deploy-bot scheduled (maria)
- oncall assigned (sre-bot)
- rollback bundle available (olivia)
kevin: All green from my side.
devsecops: KMS key thumbprint: a1b2c3d4e5f6 — verified.
deploy-bot: canary started on targets: (az-private-1-node03, az-private-1-node07, az-private-1-node11). timestamp=3885075300
maria: Monitoring logs now. Pulling installer logs tail: `journalctl -u onprem-installer -n 200`
kevin: cosign verify output: "Signature verified for onprem-installer.tar.gz" on all three canaries. sha256 checks passed.
olivia: First 5m look good, pods coming up. no crashes. :thumbsup:
ryan: After 12m one node showed kube readiness delay ~6m, but recovery succeeded. This stays within our threshold (<10%).
maria: Keep observing for full 15m. If clean, we'll roll full.
maria: 02:32 UTC — canary healthy, initiating full rollout in same change window with 10m batch ramp and 5s inter-host throttle.
deploy-bot: full rollout in progress. batches=10m, throttle=5s, fallback=manifest:installer@sha256:oldfallbacksha
sre-bot: Alert rule temporarily relaxed for rollout to avoid noisy page for transient pod restarts (will re-enable post-rollout).
kevin: Republished cosign and manifest to mirror nodes. transport verifications recorded.
ryan: FYI: we saw one unexpected postinstall error on a non-canary host (node23) after batch 3, error: "failed to load kernel module: insufficient permissions". Rollback needed?
maria: Check if it's configuration drift — try re-run preflight on node23 and redeploy package to node23 only. If persists, abort and fallback to pinned manifest.
olivia: Re-run of preflight returned node-specific SELinux policy blocking load. Ops applying temporary policy allow, re-run succeeded. Node23 back in.
maria: Full rollout completed at 03:42 UTC. Post-rollout metrics look good. Closing window and filing release notes.
kevin: I'll attach final checksums + cosign receipts to the release notes doc.
maria: Thanks everyone. Filing follow-up action: track kernel module SELinux edge-case and add to preflight next time.
deploy-bot: rollout completed successfully · summary: canary(3) -> full(>150 hosts) -> duration 1h27m · no automatic rollback triggered.
kevin: Marking artifacts as sealed: sealed_manifest_epoch=20260311-epoch7
maria: Release notes draft linked: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/onprem/1.9.0
olivia: leaving postmortem checklist items in #postmortems if anything comes up.
ryan: Good job team. :rocket:
